items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I worked with Lawrence Tucker... Who was in that band? ... The drum, Albert Jobs.

ctx.x: Anderson Minor, I played with him too. Were you regular with him or you? No, just played Spot Jobs with Anderson Minor. Carnival Parades. Carnival Parades. Yeah. Different thing, you know. You worked, I believe, with Lawrence Tucker. I worked with Lawrence Tucker. Was that a regular band? That was a regular band, but that was back in 1928, in 27, you know. Who was in that band? Well, Melvin Frank was in that band, Clannette. Yeah. I was the trombone player, Eddie Summers. Bill Hamilton, he was banjo. Yeah. And…
Yeah. Drums. Who was the drums? The drum, Albert Jobs. Oh, yeah. What was that? Do you know where you played? You played in different places?
No, we played in different places. Spot jobs. All around dance halls, bunkers. Yeah.
